newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Treasury posts 1.008 bln real Oct deficit.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Treasury posts 1.008 bln real Oct deficit.

text.p: Brazil's Treasury posted a 1.008 billion real deficit in October under the cash concept, bringing the deficit for the year so far to 6.392 billion reais, the National Treasury said in a statement.
It said receipts totalled 8.347 billion reais and expenditures were 9.355 billion reais in October, compared with 8.163 billion reais and 9.706 billion respectively for October 1995.
The Treasury posted a 408 million real deficit in September 1996.

The Treasury's primary result for October was a 32 million real surplus and the operational deficit for the month came in at 1.271 billion reais, the statement said. The primary result excludes interest payments, while operational balance includes them.
The Treasury said its operational deficit for the first 10 months of the year represented 0.85 percent of gross domestic product versus a deficit of 1.05 percent of GDP in the same period a year ago.
Real interest payments on Treasury obligations in October 1996 totalled 1.302 billion reais versus 1.489 billion reais in September 1996 and 1.1 billion reais in October 1995, it said.

The Treasury added that of 4.525 billion reais of ordinary expenditures, 3.046 billion reais was spent on payroll and social security payments in October 1996 versus 2.784 billion reais out of total ordinary expenditure of 4.595 billion reais in September 1996.
